spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a pale ground. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-tan head with large dark eyes and a wide mouth, with multiple feathery pinkish-red gill stalks projecting from the neck immediately behind the head. The body is stout and low to the ground, with a strongly arched back completely covered in overlapping dark brown scales with lighter edges, continuing onto the top of the long thick tail that extends to the left out of the frame. The underside of the body, the neck, and the four thick limbs are bare, pale, wrinkled and fleshy, and each limb ends in a splayed foot with small dark claws. The overall skin of the head and limbs is smooth with visible folds at the joints and neck, and the scales have a ridged, keratinous texture.

meta_spark.description: A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in three-quarter side view facing right. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-beige fleshy head like a salamander with large dark glossy eyes, tiny nostrils, and a wide mouth, with multiple pink feathery external gill stalks fanning from the sides of the head behind the eyes. The underside, sides of the body, head, and short sturdy legs are covered in wrinkled pale pink skin, while the entire arched back from the neck over the body and onto the long tapering tail is covered in overlapping large dark brown rounded keratin scales. It stands on four short thick legs ending in broad five-toed clawed feet.
